Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an interactome screen. The primary biological variable is the presence/absence of endogenous DYRK1A (WT vs KO) to filter non-specific interactors. While the text mentions ionizing radiation (IR) and siRNA/shRNA knockdown, these were used for functional validation assays (clonogenic assays, IVK) and not for the primary MS-based interactome screen.
